card.name: Dictionary definitions before someone/something
card.fires_on: Short linking words like for, that, do, or allow inside dictionary-style definitions, just before an indefinite 'someone' or 'something'. It appears in learner-dictionary entries and phrasal verb glosses.

modes.label: Verb gloss + for/that
modes.description: A linking word in a definition of a verb sense, right before 'someone'.

modes.label: 'do' before something
modes.description: The verb 'do' or similar in a gloss, followed by 'something'.
modes.example: get around to (inseparable):<< do>> something eventually.

modes.label: Agree/decide that
modes.description: The word 'that' after agree or decide in a definition, before someone or what someone says.

card.writes: It promotes words like 'notably' and 'notamment', and suppresses 'some'-type words (某, somewhere, somehow), so it seems to steer away from vague 'some-' words after the marked word.
card.plain: It fires in dictionary definitions on the small word just before 'someone' or 'something'.
